selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and persistent firewalld policy contains only SSH and TCP/8080 with an explicit REJECT target. External-style testing connected successfully to ports 22 and 8080, while a live listener on port 8081 was rejected.

Pre-restart boot ID was 33b0e84c-4dd1-406a-8f89-2e8ceca97bd6. The reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 62074a07-3258-4a62-b71e-fd814a8f0d4c. Firewalld and SSH recovered, the persistent rules remained active, and post-restart connection tests again allowed 22/8080 and rejected 8081.

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /tmp
nohup /usr/bin/python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8080 >/tmp/fwtest-8080.log 2>&1 & printf '%s\n' "$!" | sudo -n tee /tmp/fwtest-8080.pid >/dev/null
nohup /usr/bin/python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8081 >/tmp/fwtest-8081.log 2>&1 & printf '%s\n' "$!" | sudo -n tee /tmp/fwtest-8081.pid >/dev/null
sleep 1
netstat -lnt | sed -n '/:8080 /p;/:8081 /p'
printf 'server8080_pid='; sudo -n cat /tmp/fwtest-8080.pid
printf 'server8081_pid='; sudo -n cat /tmp/fwtest-8081.pid

sudo -n /sbin/ip netns exec fwtest /usr/bin/python - <<'PY'
import socket
import sys
host = "192.0.2.1"
failed = False
for port in (22, 8080, 8081):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(3)
    try:
        s.connect((host, port))
        if port == 22:
            detail = s.recv(80).strip()
        elif port == 8080:
            s.sendall("GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: firewall-test\r\n\r\n")
            detail = s.recv(80).split("\r\n", 1)[0]
        else:
            detail = "unexpected connection"
            failed = True
        print("port=%d result=connected detail=%s" % (port, detail))
    except socket.error as exc:
        print("port=%d result=rejected error=%s" % (port, exc))
        if port in (22, 8080):
            failed = True
    finally:
        s.close()
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
PY
